purpose: Preserve an exact ILOSTAT Nigeria labour-context extract for review; it is not a role-vacancy or role-priority seed.

source.dataset_label: Employment by sex and occupation -- ILO modelled estimates, Nov. 2025 (thousands)

observations_thousands.label: Plant and machine operators, and assemblers
Elementary occupations and skilled agricultural, forestry and fishery workers

permitted_use: Broad Nigerian labour-context display or research context.
A signal for deciding where a detailed, role-level Nigerian demand study may be worthwhile.
Cross-checking that domain explanations do not imply that all Nigerian work is formal professional employment.
limitations: These are modelled estimates, not a direct vacancy count or employer preference dataset.
The extract is at ISCO major-group level and cannot identify demand for an individual Sifter role, subgroup, skill, tool, certification, or programme.
It must not by itself reorder entry, mid, or senior roles or be displayed as evidence that a specific role is locally available.
Detailed observed Nigerian labour evidence requires the exact underlying national survey extract, period, classification level, and mapping record.
